theme: repair shop front desk quoting turnaround times
title: Counterdesk Commitments: Repair Shop Turnaround Quotes
strategies: mean-field forecast baseline: track a single pooled backlog counter drained at rate C, quote exactly that forecast, admit iff forecast <= patience (reproduces the evaluator's weak reference)

per-bench list-scheduling forecast: simulate the C actual bench free-times online, quote the true earliest-available-bench delay -- more accurate than the pooled estimate, but still announces the forecast itself as the binding promise

commitment-priced quoting: once a job is worth admitting, always quote AT the patience ceiling (the loosest delay the customer will still accept) instead of your best-guess forecast, since any tighter promise only adds violation risk with no upside

value-first global admission with feasibility lookback: scan the whole arrival trace, offer jobs in descending value order, and admit a job only if doing so (at its patience-ceiling quote) does not blow any already-committed higher-value job's deadline under the true earliest-deadline-first dispatch -- pre-empts low-value burst jobs from ever consuming bench priority that higher-value jobs nearby will need
